description: Database drift repair: production's schema_migrations says 003 ran, but the tags table it creates is missing. Write an idempotent repair migration that converges the drifted database without touching the recorded history - the gate proves convergence, data preservation and a clean fresh install.

criteria: A new migration (004+) converges the drifted database to the full schema - tags table present with the columns 003 defines - while the existing rows survive (no drop-and-recreate of user tables), a fresh database migrates cleanly past the repair, and the recorded history 001-003 plus the drifted snapshot and the runner stay untouched.
